notes.title: UPDATE - PATCH 0.5 - FURTHER IMPROVEMENTS + PRICE CHANGE
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, 

We've updated the game, solved framerate issues in a few areas and updated the price. 


Cheers

notes.title: UPDATE - PATCH 0.4 - Improved spaceship maneuverability, fixed player collision, improved jump, removed camera effects
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've made a few changes:

- The space ship now turns faster left, right and up, down and it's a lot of fun to play with it

- Player collision no longer gets stuck to objects

- Fixed a bug regarding the jumping speed and gravity force

- Removed permeanent camera effect (dust) and added the effect around the world 


Next update will have:

- Player will no longer slightly move when platforms are moving

- Improve framerate

- Add additional sounds (birds, insects, aliens)


Thank you!

notes.title: UPDATE - PATCH 0.3 - FIXED DOUBLE JUMP - FIXED WALKING - AND MORE
notes.notes:
Hello,


- We've fixed the bug where you could press Space and jump twice. 

- We also fixed the bug where you kept forward key and the character wouldn't stop immediately.

- We fixed a bug related to the green UFO, you'd take it, quit game and then your progression would be blocked.

More fixes are coming soon. If you've seen something that needs an absolute fix, let us know. 

Thank you!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.2 - BUG FIXING - COLLECTIBLES - SOUND
notes.notes:
Hello,

We've fixed bugs regarding collectibles in the city, some collision bugs and improved sound.

Thank you.

notes.title: Please leave a REVIEW
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

We're always looking to improve and fix what you guys don't like, so please, if you have bought the game, leave a sincere review and we'll do our best to change things and improve Riverhill Trials and our future games.

Thank you for your support,
Watercolor Games

notes.title: UPDATE 0.1 - Mouse Cursor Removed + Larger Crates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We've removed the mouse cursor from the game (beside menu and pause menu).

Please contact us on our discussion board OR email us at contact@riverhilltrials.com for any tips or feedback.

Thank you!

Thank you.
